# Recording

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Recording`](gmeow-Recording.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Recording>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A concrete audio manifestation of a musical work or expression — a take, master, released track, or any other fixed sound recording. Co-equal sibling of [`gmeow:ScoreEdition`](gmeow-ScoreEdition.md) and other manifestations ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Recording`](gmeow-Recording.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a fixed sound recording at the [`Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) tier — a take, master, or released track; the audio sibling of [`gmeow:ScoreEdition`](gmeow-ScoreEdition.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the abstract composition ([`gmeow:MusicalWork`](gmeow-MusicalWork.md)) and for a notated edition ([`gmeow:ScoreEdition`](gmeow-ScoreEdition.md)); a recording is not privileged over a score ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Link the [`Recording`](gmeow-Recording.md) to its [`Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md) with [`gmeow:embodies`](../properties/gmeow-embodies.md), set an audio [`gmeow:hasManifestationFormat`](../properties/gmeow-hasManifestationFormat.md), and relate samples/remixes to it through [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) at the recording tier.

### Examples

- ex:eroica1963 a [`gmeow:Recording`](gmeow-Recording.md); [`gmeow:embodies`](../properties/gmeow-embodies.md) ex:eroicaPerformedExpr; [`gmeow:hasManifestationFormat`](../properties/gmeow-hasManifestationFormat.md) [`gmeow:formatStreamingAudio`](../individuals/gmeow-formatStreamingAudio.md).
